column1: # 30-home-server.tsv: home-server apps (kind serverapp). The id is the recipe folder name under linux/files/server-apps/ and the app is set up with
# "secure-linux-server-apps install ID". Setup never installs these by itself (default off, and the library only lists them).
# Columns (TAB separated): id kind title plain_description approx_size_mb profiles default arch idea
# The size is the compressed download of the app's container images for Intel and AMD, taken from the registry on 2026-11-17 (rounded up);
# the app's own data and the unpacked images need more room: the recipe's min_free_gb is what the set-up checks before it starts.
